answer: Every proof carries its date, so a proof painted yesterday cannot pretend to be a year old. Give the epoch its backbone: Excise clerk dark molasses proof distilled at the still house, shown by each dark molasses is a measured grain yield plus a distiller's signature, judged by strangers who owe the applicant nothing. Proof sells at 83 POA a piece; the farm's 669 pieces lock 55527 POA away, gone for good if it cheats. Time keeps the vault, the ledger keeps the forge, the toy shop keeps the mirror; the farm keeps nothing but its printer.
